chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.com (US) item nutrition, every size McDonald's lists for an item (12 Nov 2026). Allergens are the ones McDonald's lists for each part of the item

chains.name: Chick-fil-A
chains.src: Chick-fil-A Nutrition & Allergens (13 Nov 2026). Salads are as Chick-fil-A lists them for each protein. Chick-fil-A cooks in refined peanut oil, which the FDA doesn't count as an allergen, so its table doesn't list it

chains.name: Wendy's
chains.src: Wendy's US online menu, national (no store chosen) (12 Nov 2026). The national menu shows one size: Jr. fries and Frosty, small drinks. Full-sugar fountain drinks are left out because that menu lists them at 0 Cal. Salads come without and with their dressing packet, which Wendy's lists on its own

chains.name: Taco Bell
chains.src: tacobell.com item pages and the Nutritionix label each one links under Nutrition Info, every drink size (13 Nov 2026). Rounded the way Taco Bell's label rounds them (FDA rules)

chains.name: Panda Express
chains.src: Panda Express Nutrition & Allergen Information (13 Nov 2026). Sides and entrées are listed on their own, as Panda does; a bowl is one side and one entrée. Drinks are by cup size in fl oz

chains.name: Burger King
chains.src: Burger King Nutrition Explorer (14 Nov 2026), each item as served with its standard toppings. Allergens are the ones Burger King lists as contained; may-contain includes shared cooking equipment

chains.name: Popeyes
chains.src: Popeyes USA Nutrition Guide (November 2026, checked 14 Nov 2026). Classic and spicy chicken share one row, as Popeyes lists them. No allergens yet: they're in a separate chart
